Maya (Marketing): Quick request for launch materials: can runtime produce a reproducible bench package that includes coldstart vs warmup splits, quantized vs fp16 comparisons, and 50-sample quality snapshots? Need gen single-turn (~1k tokens), chat long-context (16k), and embedding latency. Target: deck + webinar. Deadline EOD Wed.

Priya (Runtime): Yep. Two clarifying items: exact model names and which quant profiles, and do you want per-batch breakdowns for cost math? Also should we include streaming traces for generation and trace-level KV-cache priming data?

Maya (Marketing): Use redwood-3-small and redwood-3-medium. Run fp16 and int8-quant (our production profile). Include batches 1, 8, 32. Streaming traces yes for gen; embeddings not streaming. For cost, show cost/token delta and cost per 1M tokens. Warmup policy: 2 warmup requests per instance and 100k warmup tokens where supported. Coldstart means zero warmup.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): I'll help with canary. Please upload the sample payload set (n=50) and seed list so runs are reproducible. Also note: long-context runs are heavy; we may need to cap concurrency or drop batch 32 for long chat on medium model if nodes are constrained.

Maya (Marketing): Uploading payloads: https://redwood.internal/samples/launch-gen50.json and seeds: https://redwood.internal/seeds/launch-2026.txt. If resources are tight, prioritize batch 1 and 8 for medium long-context.

Priya (Runtime): Plan: canary -> smoke -> full sweep. Command we'll use:

```\n./bench-run \
  --models redwood-3-small,redwood-3-medium \
  --quant none,int8-prod \
  --batch-sizes 1,8,32 \
  --seq-len 1024 --long-seq 16384 \
  --seed-file launch-2026.txt \
  --payloads launch-gen50.json \
  --warmup-reqs 2 --warmup-tokens 100000 \
  --coldstart --stream-gen-traces \
  --output /bench-artifacts/launch-6179991234\n```

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-6179991234-canary (ETA ~2.5h). :gear:

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Note for priya: add tracer tags: dataset:launch-gen50, campaign:webinar, run_id:6179991234. Also enable per-request labels so marketing can sample outputs easily.

Sam (Product): For the deck we need p50/p95/p99, cost/token, and a 2-3 sentence methodology blurb that explains warmup vs coldstart and canary->sweep. Also ask for a one-slide example of failure modes (noisy neighbor, OOM on long-context) with mitigations.

Priya (Runtime): We'll provide: (1) canary gist when it finishes with early p50/p95, (2) full artifact bundle with raw traces, aggregated percentiles, cost estimates, sample outputs, and exact run environment (docker image, kernel, GPU). If we hit resource constraints we'll drop batch 32 for medium/long context and note it in methodology.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Please ping immediately when canary p50/p95 are available so we can start slide copy. If the canary shows big regressions on int8 quality, flag QA asap.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Canary starting now, capping concurrency to 4 to reduce noise. bench-bot posted logs.

bench-bot: bench-6179991234-canary started on small-node-3. Logs: https://bench-logs/6179991234/canary

Priya (Runtime): Canary finished. Early numbers: redwood-3-small fp16 batch1 gen p95 ~120ms (streaming), int8 ~135ms; embedding p95 ~45ms. Uploading gist with run summary and samples: https://bench-artifacts/6179991234/canary-gist.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect — thanks team. We'll draft slide text from the canary and await full sweep artifacts.

Priya (Runtime): Full sweep queued. ETA for bundle ~48h. I'll annotate any skipped configs (e.g., medium+32 for 16k) in the methodology note.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.
